description.zh: 数据校验方式，当前仅支持取值为**1**，表示全量校验。
description.en: The data verification method. Currently, only the value **1** is supported, which indicates full verification.
The name of the source database to be verified.
The ID of the DTS task. You can call [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) to obtain the ID.
The ID of the resource group.

description.zh: 源数据库中校验的表名。
description.en: The name of the table in the source database to be verified.

title.zh: 查询校验报告的下载地址
title.en: Query the download URL of a verification report

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts describe-data-check-report-url --check-type 1 --db-name dtsdb --tb-name student --dts-job-id f4612nr21820000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
